question: Which of the following is a protected biosphere situated in Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Manas National Park** is a **UNESCO World Heritage site**, a **Project Tiger reserve**, an **elephant reserve**, and a **biosphere reserve **in **Assam**, India.
 
• Located in the Himalayan foothills, it is **contiguous with the Royal Manas National Park in Bhutan**.
 
• The park is known for its rare and endangered endemic wildlife such as the **Assam roofed turtle, hispid hare, golden langur, and pygmy hog**.
 
• Manas is also famous for its population of **wild water buffalo**.
 
• The park is divided into three ranges:** Bansbari (Central), Panbari (Western), and Bhuiapara (Eastern)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sunderban**

 
 
• Located in the Indian state of **West Bengal**, it is the **largest tidal halophytic mangrove forest** in the world.
 
• The region is densely covered by mangrove forests and is one of the largest reserves for the **Bengal tiger**.
 
 
 
• **Nanda Devi**
 
 
• Located in the state of **Uttarakhand**, it is a part of the **Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers National Parks**, a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
 
• The park is known for its **rich variety of flora and fauna**, including several rare and endangered species.
